save.text: Giveaway: At 4,200 subs LL1973 won a signed 5e Player's Handbook + cast photo; more at every +50 subs (next 4,250).

No Critical Role next week due to San Diego Comic-Con; panel Thursday at Petco Park: Geek & Sundry panel 1–2pm (Matt, Laura), Critical Role panel 4–5pm; no badge needed; panel will be filmed and streamed the following day.
Following week: Matt and Marisha in New Zealand for Armageddon; two weeks without main-story; remaining cast will stream other games/chat.
Remote: Liam is Skyping in from upstate New York near the Canadian border.
Charity tonight: GameChanger (cancer charity) in partnership with Square Enix; $1 donations get Deus Ex PC codes; presentation at break.
Sam Riegel and Taliesin Jaffe are late due to traffic but expected shortly.
Technical: Intro video froze; stream continued without it.
Sam Riegel arrived mid-opening; cast paused to let him in.
Technical: Intro video not working; stream is live; they did a brief live intro instead.
Recap by Matt: Party en route by skyship to Vasselheim (Platinum Sanctuary) to seal Horn of Orcus; recently fought wyvern/griffin raiders, took a captive; journey ~6–7 days total.
Captive mage from raiders is bound and locked in the ship’s anti-magic brig; Captain Damon refused hiring her after attack.
Several uneventful travel days pass over the Ozmit Sea; party fully rested with spells returned; Percy reading.
Grog’s magically induced beard grows to ~1–1.5 inches, translucent/gray; Keyleth braids it with beads/flowers.
Grog’s beard now dark brown, thick braided goatee ~3–4 inches; previously thought translucent/gray; Grog proud.
By mid-6th travel day skies cloud; colder northern weather; natural per Keyleth Nature 20.
Tiberius persuades Scanlan to trade: Scanlan agrees to swap his circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone after debate.
Trade resolved: Scanlan swapped his circlet/crown for Tiberius’s Ioun Stone; party praises deal; Matt narrates stone orbiting Scanlan’s head.
Weather shifts colder with specks of snow as they near Vasselheim; noted by Matt; follows earlier Nature check by Keyleth.
Keyleth reveals Fire Ashari reside at Pyrah in Vasselheim; her Aramente requires visiting headmasters; proposes visiting after sealing the Horn; party agrees to support her leadership display.
Keyleth reveals her mother left when Keyleth was ~5–6; tribe unknown; unsure if alive.
Landfall: Sight Othanzia; Vesper Timberland forests with light snow; Kima guides, calls it interesting.
Approaching Vasselheim: vast fortified mountain city larger than Emon; layered ancient-to-modern walls with dragon-headed ballistae; built to withstand sieges.
Vasselheim shows repeated battle scars; walls and buildings rebuilt multiple times; very old city; improvised skyship docking atop a mill; skyships rare here.
Party arrives Vasselheim; cold weather. Vex had bought winter coats for group earlier; fancy robes also present. Scanlan takes large fancy robe, ‘girded’.
Scanlan stores a 3rd-level Lightning Bolt into the white Ioun Stone (glows greenish-blue); spell slot spent now, available after rest.
Kima hasn’t been with her Order for ~8 years; nervous about meeting them; they’re about to meet the Order now.
Scalebearer Yonn leads armored escorts; will take Horn to Platinum Sanctuary; ~25-minute walk.
In Vasselheim, arcane practice largely disallowed; city is divine-focused; Yonn: only he, Vox Machina, and Highbearer Vord know of the Horn’s arrival.
Vasselheim guards display holy symbols; prevalent deities seen: Erathis, Avandra, Melora, a few Bahamut; none of Sarenrae.
Arcane displays discouraged; Yonn warned Tiberius after he cast Alter Self to appear metallic gold.
Escort formation to Platinum Sanctuary: Keyleth scouting as eagle, Vex on rooftops (botched stealth, drew attention), Grog/Ashley on path, Tiberius taking rear, Vax blending in (stealth 23).
Vasselheim: oldest known bastion; tens of thousands of years; holiest city with oldest good/neutral temples; arcane deemed profane in public, tightly controlled.
Carrying the Horn in a 1.5–2ft platinum/silver engraved box with blue sapphires; draws notice but no gawking; guarded escort; can cover with cloth if desired.

Approach Platinum Sanctuary: long staircase up mountain; fortress ancient, weathered; three later-added ivory/silver spires; Bahamut symbol on doors; Draconic inscriptions: honor, justice (very old form).
Vasselheim city guards called Bastions: volunteer militia; about a quarter of populace; patchwork armor. Bahamut temple envoys wear blue/silver robes, distinct.
Forest outside Vasselheim has large serpentine multi-bodied creature; ballista used from walls; screech and retreat—seems a common occurrence.
Keyleth left temple to scout as eagle; Percy/Liam nearly followed but group enters; Keyleth re-enters via arrow slit, confronted by Platinum Dragon guards, claims Vox Machina affiliation.
Keyleth detained by Platinum Dragon guards; shackled, then released immediately when Kima asserted authority; guards embarrassed and withdrew.
Temple guards here called Scalebearers (e.g., Yonn). They respect Kima’s status; quickly defer to her.
Platinum Sanctuary interior: plain ancient stone fortress, smells of age; strongly divine—Pike senses intense holy energy beyond her norm.
Scalebearer Yonn opens inner doors with Bahamut symbol; central domed worship chamber with ancient mural of creation: planes layout, Bahamut battling Tiamat.
Highbearer Vord (elder elf, Kima’s mentor) greets party; confirms box holds a Horn of Orcus and says it must be sealed immediately; advises not to open container.
Tiamat is confirmed alive; Scalebearers and Kima react gravely to inquiry.

Highbearer Vord explains plan: seal Horn in Hall of the Exalt vault beneath temple; vault once held Bahamut relic Star of Exaltation; lower chambers currently infested by subterranean spider creatures; some defenses triggered by Scalebearer Yonn; party to clear beasts and escort Scalebearers carrying box.

Star of Exaltation: crystal born from Bahamut’s tear in the Dawn War; used 300 years ago during a siege to protect Vasselheim; its power expended by Bahamut’s will and the artifact ceased to exist; chamber remains and is maintained.
Scalebearer Yonn fled infestation after initiating some vault defenses; Highbearer Vord defends his long service despite addled mind.
Vex uses Primeval Awareness: no dragons within six miles of Vasselheim at this time.
Highbearer Vord offers 3,000 gp total as reward; Scanlan (Deception 30) persuades to grant it upon sealing the Horn.
Party proceeds immediately to clear infested vault to seal Horn; Kima accompanies and leads them down into musty storage levels beneath the temple.
Kima uses her holy symbol to dispel an illusory wood wall, revealing a stone doorway and stairs into the vault; five prestigious ceremonial guards stationed at entry.
First chamber: 50x50 ft, ~20 ft high, low sconces, thick white mist refills rapidly from dragon-mouth pillars; pillars have slight gap at base indicating rotation/pivot.
Keyleth casts Gust of Wind to clear mist temporarily; Tiberius briefly casts then cancels Light due to fog glare; party remains at stairway as mist refills.

Mist trap triggered when Vax brushed barrier; dragon-mouth pillars emit spinning fiery flames; Keyleth, Scanlan, Pike failed Dex saves took 24 fire; Tiberius 12; Vax evaded all via successful save/Uncanny Dodge.
Party briefly split by refilling mist; Keyleth burns second Gust of Wind to clear central path carefully; remaining party and Scalebearers rush through within the minute.
Mist room re-fills after party and Scalebearers cross; room behind now fully obfuscated.
Next chamber is circular, floor covered in marked circles; open wide stairway (20 ft) descends on far side; no door, unlit until Light arrow.
Vax triggers circle: room begins rotating; floor circles piston as pillars into ceiling at varying intervals; acrobatics gauntlet; Vax takes 40 bludgeoning from being slammed, then continues.
Vax acrobatics 23; badly bruised/broken ribs; reaches far staircase side out of danger; room still rotating with piston pillars.
Perception 25 by Vax: in center ceiling, a coin-sized hole appears only when central pillar retracts; pillars keep slamming.
Vex attempts precision shot at ceiling hole; Scanlan inspires (d10); Tiberius ready to assist; Vex rolls 35 attack as arrow threads between pillars.
Vex’s 35-shot succeeds: arrow ricochets into coin-sized ceiling hole; arcane force slams it up, jamming mechanism; grinding debris falls; pillars scrape then stop, room halts.
Party crosses safely; Vax, bruised ribs, reunites; group takes a short rest to spend hit dice; stream also takes five-minute break.
Taylor: co-founded GameChanger Charity after own illness; partners incl. Square Enix/Deus Ex; brings games/food to hospitals, scholarships; goal: hope/inspiration.

Donations tonight from Critical Role stream redirected to GameChanger via 826LA link; chat mods sharing GameChanger donation link; Deus Ex director’s cut for donations >$1; last day of promo; site briefly crashed from traffic.
Orion mentions he is currently fighting cancer; finds Taylor’s story inspirational.
